asset.description: 內外兩圈字母環的加密裝置示意圖，顯示初始對應位置

content_en.prompt: Beavers developed an encryption system using two rings, each containing all letters of the alphabet. To encode a character, find it on the outer ring and replace it with the corresponding character on the inner ring; after each character, the inner ring turns clockwise by one character. E.g. a first letter 'H' is encoded as 'U'; a second 'H' as 'T'; a second 'N' as ' '; a third 'H' as 'S'; a third 'N' as 'Z'. Example: YES is encoded as OVG.
content_en.question: The message COME AT THREE is encoded by which one of these strings?
content_en.explanation: The first character (C) encodes to A; the inner ring turns one click; the second character (O) encodes to C — at this point the correct answer can already be identified. (Answer A comes from turning the ring the wrong direction; C from not turning it at all; D from encoding in the reverse direction — inner-to-outer instead of outer-to-inner.)
content_en.ct_explanation: In cryptography, a substitution cipher replaces letters of a message with ciphertext according to a fixed system; the receiver deciphers by the inverse substitution. A simple (monoalphabetic) substitution cipher is fairly easy to break, especially if word structure is visible — here, encrypting the spaces between words hides that structure. This rotating-ring system is similar to a polyalphabetic cipher like the Vigenère cipher; the idea of rotating rings was also used in the Enigma machine.

content_zh.prompt: 海狸們為了安全傳輸資料，發明了一套加密系統，用兩個都印有全部字母的圓環運作。加密一個字元時，先在外圈找到這個字元，換成內圈對應位置的字元；每加密完一個字元，內圈就會順時針轉一格。例如：第一個'H'會被編碼成'U'；第二個'H'編碼成'T'；第二個'N'編碼成' '(空格)；第三個'H'編碼成'S'；第三個'N'編碼成'Z'。範例：YES會被編碼成OVG。
content_zh.question: 訊息「COME AT THREE」會被編碼成下面哪一串字？
content_zh.explanation: 訊息的第一個字元(C)會被編碼成A；接著內圈轉一格；第二個字元(O)會被編碼成C——光看到這裡就已經能判斷出正確答案了。（選項A是內圈轉錯方向得到的結果；選項C是完全沒轉內圈得到的結果；選項D是把「內圈→外圈」的對應方向搞反了得到的結果。）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 在密碼學裡，「替代式密碼」是依照固定規則把訊息裡的字母替換成密文，接收方再用反向替代來解密。單純的替代式密碼其實不難破解，尤其是當你能看出單字結構的時候——這一題連單字間的空格都一起加密，正好隱藏了這個結構。這種「轉動圓環」的加密方式，類似維吉尼亞密碼(Vigenère cipher)這種多套字母表的替代式密碼；「轉動圓環」這個概念，後來也被應用在二戰時期的恩尼格瑪密碼機（Enigma）上。
